# GREENFIX — Property Maintenance & Exterior Care

> GreenFix Exterior Care (Greenfix Exterior Care Ltd, Companies House 17241761) is a property maintenance and exterior repair contractor based in Preston, Lancashire. It provides painting and decorating, landlord property refreshes, grounds and garden care and exterior repairs for homeowners, landlords and businesses. New for 2026. £5M public liability insurance; Environment Agency registered waste carrier.

## Services and guide prices
- Domestic salt spreading and winter gritting: private residential driveways, paths, steps, ramps and entrances. One-off or planned visits by agreement. https://greenfixexterior-care.co.uk/salt-spreading
- Winter home maintenance in Preston: gritting, blocked drains, waterlogged garden and surface drainage, gutter clearance, exterior window and door resealing, paving and storm repairs. https://greenfixexterior-care.co.uk/winter-property-maintenance-preston
- Storm damage repairs: fencing, gates, roof tiles and suitable exterior repairs, subject to assessment, safe access and weather. Quotation required; contact us for availability. https://greenfixexterior-care.co.uk/storm-damage-repairs
- Painting and decorating: interior and exterior work, quotation required. https://greenfixexterior-care.co.uk/services/painting-decorating
- Landlord and letting agent property maintenance: rental refreshes and planned maintenance, quotation required. https://greenfixexterior-care.co.uk/services/landlord-property-maintenance
- PAT testing: planned service, coming soon. Bookings are not open; launch requires confirmed training, equipment and insurance. Portal reports and appliance registers are future work, not currently available. https://greenfixexterior-care.co.uk/services/pat-testing
Guide "from" prices, confirmed after a free assessment.
- Grounds & garden care: grounds maintenance (from £40), garden maintenance (from £40), lawn mowing (from £20), hedge trimming (from £40), garden tidy-ups and clearance (from £80), pressure washing of driveways, patios and paths (from £95), window cleaning (free quote; external from £1.10 per pane).
- Exterior repairs: brick repointing (from £30/m²), brick repairs (from £50), garden wall repairs (from £50), fence repairs (from £85), fence panel replacement (from £85), gate repairs (from £65), patio repairs (from £95), paving repairs (from £65), slab relaying (from £95), roof tile repairs (from £250), drain and drainage repairs (from £95), window repairs (from £65), door repairs (from £65).
- Monthly garden maintenance plans, fortnightly visits, paid monthly by Direct Debit via GoCardless: Lawn Package £39/month, Silver Package £59/month (adds hedge trimming, up to 3 hedges), Gold Package £79/month (adds weeding of beds and borders). Details and sign-up: https://greenfixexterior-care.co.uk/garden-maintenance-subscription
- Also offered, quoted after a free assessment: porch repairs, lime mortar repointing.
- Quotation only: exterior structural repairs, general repairs and maintenance, residential property maintenance, planned preventative maintenance, drone property inspections.

## Who we work with
Homeowners, landlords, property managers, supermarkets, retail parks, business parks, nursing homes, council premises, warehouses, factories, schools, clinics, hospitality, churches and other privately managed premises.

## Service area
Preston, Lancashire, including Penwortham, Fulwood and Leyland.

## Naming
Preferred name: "GreenFix Exterior Care". Previously referred to as "GreenFix Property Care". Not affiliated with other businesses called Greenfix.

## FAQ
Q: Is GreenFix a gardening company or a builder?
A: Both: regular grounds and garden care, plus one-off exterior repairs.

Q: Is GreenFix insured?
A: Yes: £5M public liability insurance, and it is an Environment Agency registered waste carrier.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Call or WhatsApp 07447 804597 or email admin@greenfixexterior-care.co.uk. Replies within 24 hours.
